title: Present Simple vs Continuous & Stative Verbs
completion_message: ¡Excelente! Has dominado la diferencia entre acciones temporales, rutinas y verbos de estado.

stages.title: Presente Simple vs Continuo y Verbos de Estado

parts.visual: Present Simple (Rutinas y verdades): I work in London (Siempre). Present Continuous (Temporal y ahora): I am working in Paris this week (Solo por esta semana).
parts.audio: Present Simple for routines and permanent facts. I work in London. Present Continuous for temporary situations and actions happening right now. I am working in Paris this week.

parts.visual: Stative Verbs (Verbos de Estado): Verbos de pensamiento, posesión y emoción NO se usan en forma continua (-ing). Ejemplos: know (saber), believe (creer), understand (entender), want (querer), need (necesitar), own (poseer). CORRECTO: I know the answer. INCORRECTO: I am knowing the answer.
parts.audio: Stative verbs. Verbs of thinking, possession, and emotion are NOT used in the continuous form with I-N-G. Examples: know, believe, understand, want, need, and own. It is correct to say: I know the answer. Never say: I am knowing the answer.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la forma correcta del verbo (rutina, temporal o estado).

questions.question: I usually ____ at 9:00 AM, but today I ____ at 8:00 AM.
questions.explanation: Usually indica rutina (Present Simple). Today indica una situación temporal o actual (Present Continuous).

questions.question: She ____ the new strategy. It makes sense. (Entiende - Verbo de estado).
questions.explanation: 'Understand' es un stative verb, no lleva -ing.

questions.question: They ____ to open a new branch next year. (Quieren - Verbo de estado).
questions.explanation: 'Want' es un stative verb, nunca se dice 'are wanting'.

questions.question: We normally ____ meetings in Room A, but this week we ____ them in Room B.
questions.explanation: Normally = Present Simple (have). This week = Situación temporal (are having).

questions.question: I ____ you are right about the budget. (Creo - Verbo de estado).
questions.explanation: 'Believe' (creer) es un verbo de estado, no lleva -ing.

questions.question: Look! The CEO ____ to the investors right now.
questions.explanation: Right now indica una acción en progreso (Present Continuous).

questions.question: I ____ to the office every day. (Manejo - Rutina permanente).
I ____ my car this week because the train is on strike. (Estoy manejando - Temporal).
questions.explanation: This week indica situación temporal (Present Continuous).

questions.question: Do you ____ the password for the Wi-Fi? (Saber/Conocer - Verbo de estado).
questions.explanation: 'Know' es un stative verb. Nunca se dice 'are you knowing'.

questions.question: The company ____ three factories in Asia. (Posee - Verbo de posesión).
questions.explanation: 'Own' (poseer) es un verbo de estado, no lleva -ing.

questions.question: I ____ we should delay the launch. (Pienso/Opino - Verbo de estado).
questions.explanation: Cuando 'think' significa opinar/creer, es un verbo de estado (no -ing).

questions.question: Shh! I ____ about the problem. Give me a minute. (Estoy pensando - Acción mental en proceso).
questions.explanation: Cuando 'think' es el proceso mental de analizar algo en el momento, SÍ se puede usar en continuo.

questions.question: We ____ more time to finish the project. (Necesitamos - Verbo de estado).
She never ____ coffee. (Bebe - Rutina).
Why ____ you ____ at the screen like that? Is it broken? (Aahora mismo).
questions.explanation: Acción sucediendo en este momento: Why are you looking...?

questions.question: This laptop ____ to the company. (Pertenece - Verbo de posesión).
They ____ the software this month to fix the bugs. (Están actualizando - Temporal).
questions.explanation: This month = situación en progreso o temporal.

questions.question: I ____ what you mean. (Veo/Entiendo - Verbo de estado).
questions.explanation: Cuando 'see' significa entender, es stative verb.

questions.question: The manager ____ the client at 3 PM tomorrow. (Se reúne con - Plan futuro).
questions.explanation: Cuando 'see' significa reunirse con alguien (plan), sí puede ir en continuo.

questions.question: How much ____ this software ____? (Cuesta - Estado permanente).
questions.explanation: 'Cost' (costar) es stative verb. Usa auxiliar do/does.

stages.title: Written Expression
stages.description: Escribe el verbo en Present Simple o Present Continuous según corresponda.

questions.question: I ____ the answer. (know - verbo de estado)
We ____ a new website this week. (build - temporal)
She ____ the problem. (understand - verbo de estado)
They ____ help right now. (need - verbo de estado)
The company ____ the building. (own - verbo de estado)
I ____ to work every day. (drive - rutina)
I ____ this week because my car is broken. (take the bus - temporal)
Look! He ____ to the boss. (talk - ahora mismo)
I ____ you are right. (believe - verbo de estado)
We ____ more budget. (want - verbo de estado)

stages.title: Listening Comprehension
stages.description: Escucha y selecciona la frase exacta.
